segmente.text: If you want to make content that makes you loads of money, you need to know what buying
stage your audience is in.
The famous marketer Eugene Schwartz talks about the four major ones, unaware, problem
aware, solution aware, and product aware.
And each stage requires different types of content.
For example, unaware would be you having a stomach ache, but not knowing why.
So you go onto YouTube and search, why do I have a stomach ache?
And in the video, it says, you have an unhealthy gut, so now you're aware of the problem.
Next, you'll go onto Google and search how to improve gut health.
And in that video, it will show you solutions.
So now you're solution aware.
Then you'll start looking at products that improve gut health.
Now you're product aware.
As you can see, each stage requires different types of content.
Your job is to identify what stage your audience is in, so you can make content that converts
them into paying clients.
